name: Lyria RealTime
description: Experimental engine for high-fidelity musical synthesis, generating and transforming audio with deep control over melody and rhythm and no vocals. Streams 48 kHz stereo raw 16-bit PCM at a maximum control latency of 2 seconds.

sources.title: Lyria RealTime model page
sources.notes: Experimental model code and streaming limits (48kHz stereo, maximum 2 second control latency). The page states no token limits, so no context is recorded.
